headline: Everest Properties to Invest Over EGP 10 Billion in New Cairo Offices
summary: Everest Properties plans to invest over EGP 10 billion in two new office developments, Bureau 59 and Bureau 57, in New Cairo after securing required licenses and regulatory approvals.
why: Commercial real estate expansion by private developers highlights corporate demand for modern office space in Egypt's growing urban centers.

impacts.name: Everest Properties
impacts.why: The firm is committing over EGP 10 billion to expand its commercial real estate portfolio.
